ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can calculate optimal launch parameters in advance, but a trained specialist must judge whether the aircraft on deck is ready and what command comes next amid the roar of operations.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. military pay follows the Department of Defense rank and years-of-service system. Civilian BLS OES data does not cover military occupations, so this page does not provide a U.S. median. Salary references use Chinese mainland proxy data (Aiqicha and other public sources, sample of 10, 2026-08).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Aircraft Launch And Recovery Specialists, but it will assist them. Automated condition monitoring, parameter calculations, and data recording can reduce human error. Flight deck operations center on on-site command and emergency judgment. Human training, experience, and real-time reactions remain essential in extreme conditions. Automation improves safety; it does not justify removing people.
ai_s2_accel: Predictive maintenance supports flight deck equipment
ai_s2_auto: Automated monitoring of launch parameters and condition data
Digital operation records and mission logs
ai_s3_list: On-site command: signals and orders amid engine noise and jet wash.
Emergency judgment: make life-saving decisions within seconds.
Safety inspection: detect hazards in small details.
Team coordination: flight deck teamwork must have zero errors.
Mental resilience: perform consistently under high pressure and risk.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 4/10 score indicates a specialized flight deck role with limited potential for automation to replace people. Support systems can monitor and calculate, but people retain on-site command, emergency judgment, and safety accountability. AI primarily augments the role rather than replacing it.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low-moderate exposure does not mean the role will stay unchanged. Decision support and simulation training are changing how specialists train and work. Specialists who master new systems can improve efficiency and safety records. Combining professional training with new technology will make flight deck expertise even more valuable.

ai_s5_persona.建议: This path combines national service with exceptional professional standards and demands outstanding physical and mental fitness. Young people interested in it should build fitness and discipline, then enter through official military recruitment channels. Do not trust unauthorized recruiting claims.

Treat the safety record of every operation as your professional lifeline, and learn decision-support systems and simulation tools. Move toward team leader or instructor roles and train newcomers. Passing on your experience will steadily increase your value.

After military service, civilian paths include airport operations, aviation ground support, and flight simulation training. Highlight strong discipline and emergency response skills on your resume. Relevant credentials and civil aviation examinations are essential to the transition.

Joint military-civilian support and civil aviation ground operations need disciplined workers with this background. Hiring should emphasize emergency training records and teamwork experience. Training systems must support these candidates rather than waste the expertise of people who understand risk so well.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Delivery of flight deck signals and orders

ai_s7_trends: Expansion of carrier groups continues to increase demand for flight deck specialists.
Decision support and simulation training are becoming widespread, improving both safety and efficiency.
Training and judgment remain central to flight deck operations. Automation augments people rather than replacing them.

body: Aircraft Launch And Recovery Specialists organize catapult launches, arrested landings, and flight deck movements for carrier aircraft on aircraft carriers and similar platforms. They conduct safety inspections, direct operations with signals, and handle emergencies. They are a key military specialty for safe carrier aircraft launches and recoveries.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能提前算出最佳弹射参数，但「甲板上那架飞机状态对不对、下一步怎么指挥」——得靠训练有素的专员在轰鸣声里判断。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国军用薪酬由国防部等级制（军衔+年限）决定，民用 BLS OES 不统计军事职业，本页不提供美国中位数口径；薪资参考以中国大陆代理数据为准（爱企查等公开渠道，采样 10 条，2026-08）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代舰载机发射回收专员，但会辅助：状态监测、参数计算、数据记录都能自动化，减少人为差错。甲板作业的本质是「现场指挥 + 应急判断」，在极端环境里人的训练、经验和临场反应仍是核心。自动化是提升安全的手段，不是替代人的理由。
ai_s2_accel: 辅助决策系统优化弹射参数
AI 视觉辅助着舰监控
模拟训练系统提升训练效率
预测性维护保障甲板设备
ai_s2_auto: 弹射参数与状态数据自动监测
作业记录与任务日志电子化
设备状态告警自动提示
排班与任务计划自动化
ai_s3_list: 现场指挥：轰鸣与尾流中的信号与口令。
应急判断：几秒钟内做出保命决策。
安全检查：从细节里发现隐患。
团队协同：甲板上的配合必须零误差。
心理素质：高压高风险下的稳定输出。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明甲板作业是「低自动化替代」的专业岗位：辅助系统能监测和计算，但现场指挥、应急判断和安全责任依然在人的肩上，AI 主要扮演「增强」而非「取代」的角色。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于不变：辅助决策和模拟训练正在改变训练与作业方式，会用新系统的专员效率和安全记录更好。把专业训练和新技术掌握结合起来，甲板作业的价值只会更受重视。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 这是「家国情怀 + 极致专业」的路径，需要极强的身体和心理素质。建议想走的孩子先加强体能和纪律性，通过正规参军渠道进入，别轻信非正规招生信息。
把每次作业的安全记录当职业生命线，同时学习辅助决策系统与模拟训练工具。往分队长、教员方向带新人，经验传承会让你的价值持续放大。
退役转民用可走民航机场运行、航空地勤保障、飞行模拟训练等方向。把「高纪律、强应急」作为履历亮点，相关资质证书和民航考试是转型关键。
军地协同保障与民航地勤对这类纪律型人才有需求，招聘时重点看「应急训练记录 + 团队协作经历」；培训体系要接得住，别浪费这批最懂风险的人。

ai_s7_trends: 航母编队规模扩大，甲板专业人才需求持续上升。
辅助决策与模拟训练普及，作业安全与效率双提升。
甲板作业核心仍靠「训练 + 判断」，自动化是增强而非替代。

body: 舰载机发射与回收专员在航空母舰等平台上组织舰载机的弹射起飞、拦阻着舰与甲板调度，负责作业安全检查、信号指挥与应急处置，是保障舰载机起降安全的关键专业兵种。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can run experiments, but people still choose the question, the direction to prove, and the research design.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 40,300 Computer and information research scientists employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 48,300 by 2034, a net increase of about 8,000 jobs, with about 3,200 openings per year. The 2026 median annual wage is about $140,900 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Computer and information research scientists. It accelerates their work. AI assists experiments and literature review, shifting scientists from running experiments toward framing questions, validating directions, and defining paradigms. Reproduction-only work faces pressure, while people who open new research directions become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Question framing: people provide imagination.
Direction selection: people provide scientific taste.
Theoretical proof: people provide rigor.
Paradigm design: people define the framework.
Team leadership: people provide vision.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: This career has relatively high AI exposure because AI directly accelerates experiments, literature review, coding, and analysis. People retain responsibility for framing questions, proving directions, and defining research paradigms.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Relatively high exposure does not mean high career risk. Technology replaces repetitive reproduction and high-volume experimentation, not the work of opening new research directions. Scientists with strong judgment and scientific taste remain more resilient.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build strong mathematics skills and practice research early. Pure reproduction work is shrinking in the AI era, so learn to frame original questions.
Move from running experiments to framing questions and setting direction. Develop research writing and leadership skills.
Highlight papers and prototypes, and state clearly which research directions you opened.
Do not evaluate candidates on publication count alone. Look for scientific taste and the ability to identify valuable questions.

ai_s7_trends: Demand for AI research remains strong.
Accelerated experimentation becomes standard.
Researchers who open new directions face stronger demand.

body: Computer and information research scientists design and research new computational methods, algorithms, and systems, advancing the theoretical and applied frontiers of computing and information science.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能跑实验，但提什么问题、证什么方向、怎么设计，还是人定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年计算机与信息研究科学家在岗约 4.03 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 4.83 万人，净增约 0.80 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.32 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 14.09 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代研究科学家，反而加速其工作。实验与文献可由 AI 辅助，科学家从「跑实验」挪向「提问题、证方向、定范式」。真正被挤掉的是只做复现的，能开新方向的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 问题提出：想象力靠人。
方向判断：品味靠人。
理论证明：严谨靠人。
范式设计：框架靠人。
团队引领：视野靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: AI 曝光偏低——工具做辅助，提出与证明还留着人的位置，且前沿属性增强价值。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 高曝光不等于高风险：这个岗位曝光低，被替代的是「复现与跑量」动作，不是「开新方向」的岗位。有科学品味的人更稳。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 数理起步多练科研，AI 时代纯复现在缩，早点练提出力。
从「跑实验」升级成「提问题 + 定方向」，学写作与引领。
突出论文与原型，写清开过哪些方向。
选人别只看论文数，要看有没有科学品味。

ai_s7_trends: AI 研究需求强。
实验加速成标配。
能开方向者更抢手。

body: 计算机与信息研究科学家设计并研究新的计算方法、算法与系统，推动计算与信息领域的理论与应用边界。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: QR-code ordering can send orders automatically, but cooks still control service pace, sanitation, and peak-period coordination.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 669,500 Cooks, Fast Food were employed in 2024, falling to a projected 579,200 by 2034, a net decrease of about 90,300 jobs. The occupation generates about 82,100 openings per year and had a median annual wage of about $30,200 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Cooks, Fast Food, but it will speed up simple assembly. Smart fryers and assembly lines accelerate standard tasks, shifting cooks from repetitive assembly toward pace control, sanitation management, and training. Single-task assembly roles face the most pressure, while people who handle peak demand remain more resilient.
ai_s3_list: Peak-period control: people set the pace.
Sanitation management: people carry responsibility.
Incident response: people handle exceptions.
Training standards: people teach them.
Team communication: people coordinate handoffs.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 places this occupation in the low-moderate AI-exposure execution range. Equipment speeds up simple assembly, while people still control pace and sanitation.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low-moderate exposure does not mean high risk. Automation replaces isolated assembly tasks, not roles that coordinate service. Workers who handle peak demand and manage sanitation become scarcer as efficiency improves.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Fast-food work has a low entry barrier. Build speed and consistency first, then progress toward store management or full-service cooking.
Move from assembly into pace control and training. Learn scheduling and waste control, then pursue an assistant-manager role.
Emphasize peak-period experience and sanitation awareness. Chains value reliability and speed.
Hire for steadiness and resilience under pressure. Strong workers who train others deserve priority in scheduling.

ai_s7_trends: Automation absorbs simple assembly tasks.
Chains and delivery services drive demand.
Workers who handle peak periods are more resilient.

body: Cooks, Fast Food rapidly prepare standardized meals, coordinating ingredients, frying, and assembly. They use equipment and defined processes to serve orders on time while maintaining sanitation and consistency.
career_ai_description_block.heading: QR-code ordering can send orders automatically, but cooks still control service pace, sanitation, and peak-period coordination.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 扫码点餐能自动下单，但出餐节奏、卫生与高峰协作，还是厨师定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年快餐厨师在岗约 66.95 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 57.92 万人，岗位净减约 9.03 万个，年均产生约 8.21 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 3.02 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代快餐厨师，但会加速简单装配。智能炸锅与装配线把标准动作提速，厨师从重复装配挪向节奏把控、卫生管理与带训。真正被挤掉的是只做单一装配的，能扛高峰的人更稳。
ai_s3_list: 高峰把控：节奏靠人。
卫生管理：责任靠人。
突发处理：异常靠人。
带训标准：传授靠人。
协作沟通：接口靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业处在低中 AI 曝光的执行区——简单装配被设备加速，但节奏与卫生还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是单一装配动作，不是出餐协调的岗位。能扛高峰、管卫生的人，反而随提效更稀缺。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 快餐门槛低，可先练手速和标准，再往店长或正餐转。
从装配升级成管节奏 + 带训，学排班和损耗，争取副店。
突出高峰经验和卫生意识，连锁看重稳和快。
选人看稳和扛压，能带训的骨干值得给排班倾斜。

ai_s7_trends: 自动化吃简单装配。
连锁与外卖拉动需求。
能扛高峰的人更稳。

body: 快餐厨师主导标准化餐食的快速制作，统筹备料、炸制与装配，运用设备与流程手段，达成准时出餐并保持卫生与一致。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 扫码点餐能自动下单，但出餐节奏、卫生与高峰协作，还是厨师定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can read a test report and suggest medications in seconds, but when a patient says his blood pressure rises every weekend, a Family Medicine Physician knows to ask about weekend drinking. AI cannot replace that conversation.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 116,000 Family Medicine Physicians were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 119,100 by 2034, a net increase of about 3,100 jobs, with about 3,300 openings each year. The median annual wage was about $238,400 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Family Medicine Physicians, but it will take over more initial triage, test-result summaries, and documentation. Primary care physicians can spend less time searching references and writing notes and more time on clinical interviews, follow-up care, and patient relationships.
ai_s2_accel: AI medication references and drug-interaction checks
Telehealth visits and online follow-up care
ai_s2_auto: AI-assisted initial triage and preliminary assessment of common conditions
Automatic interpretation of test reports and abnormal-result alerts
Automatic generation of electronic medical records and prescription documents
Digital follow-up reminders and appointment management
ai_s3_list: Clinical interviewing and initial judgment: experience identifies the key detail in a short statement.
Continuity of care: knowing a patient for years creates a complete view that data alone cannot replace.
Patient trust: long-term relationships make patients more willing to follow medical advice.
Personalized treatment: an older adult, a pregnant patient, and a shift worker need different approaches to the same hypertension diagnosis.
Referral coordination: knowing when to refer and how to connect with specialists requires judgment.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 6/10 indicates moderate AI exposure. AI is accelerating test-result interpretation, documentation, and initial screening. Clinical interviews, continuity of care, and trusted relationships remain the core barriers to replacement.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure does not place the occupation itself at risk. AI reduces time spent writing records and reading reports, while demand shifts toward long-term relationship-based care. The greatest pressure falls on high-volume clinics that only issue prescriptions without building patient relationships.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Choosing family medicine requires commitment and a clear view of the training path: complete clinical medical education and family-medicine residency training. Primary care receives policy support. In the AI era, family medicine creates value through continuity, so develop chronic-disease management and patient communication skills.

Use AI tools to reduce administrative time and invest the savings in follow-up and chronic-disease care. Consider teaching family medicine or leading a family-doctor team. Primary care promotion and compensation policies are improving.

There is no shortcut into family medicine. A formal medical path and family-medicine residency are required. Contracted family-doctor systems are making primary care career paths clearer. Before entering, confirm that a high-volume outpatient schedule is sustainable for you.

Do not hire Family Medicine Physicians on education alone. Assess whether they can sustain long patient relationships through a chronic-care follow-up case. Primary care organizations retain physicians through competitive pay, stable appointments, and credible advancement paths.

ai_s7_trends: AI-assisted triage and documentation are expanding, returning more time to clinical interviews and follow-up care.
Growth in contracted family-doctor programs is increasing demand for continuity of care and Family Medicine Physicians.
Improving primary care pay and promotion policies are making family medicine more attractive.

body: Family Medicine Physicians provide continuous, comprehensive care to individuals and families. They diagnose common conditions, manage chronic disease, provide checkups and preventive care, and coordinate referrals. They serve as core gatekeepers in tiered healthcare systems.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can read a test report and suggest medications in seconds, but when a patient says his blood pressure rises every weekend, a Family Medicine Physician knows to ask about weekend drinking. AI cannot replace that conversation.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能三秒读完检查单、推荐用药方案，但老张说「我这血压一到周末就高」，你得多问一句「周末是不是喝酒了」——这种对话，AI 学不会。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年家庭医学医师在岗约 11.60 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 11.91 万人，净增约 0.31 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.33 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 23.84 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代家庭医学医师，但会接管首诊分诊、检查单解读和文书。全科医生从「查资料、写病历」中解放出来，把时间花在问诊、随访和医患关系上。
ai_s2_accel: AI 用药方案参考与药物交互检查
可穿戴数据辅助慢病管理
健康风险 AI 评估分层
ai_s2_auto: AI 辅助首诊分诊与常见病初步判断
检查单自动解读与异常提醒
电子病历与处方文书自动生成
随访提醒与预约管理数字化
ai_s3_list: 问诊与首诊判断：一句话里的关键信息，靠经验捕捉。
连续性照护：认识病人十几年，知道他病史全貌，是数据替代不了的。
医患信任：老病人愿意听你的，是长年积累的信任。
个性化治疗：同样的高血压，老人、孕妇、打工人方案完全不同。
转诊协调：什么时候该往上送、怎么跟专科衔接，是门艺术。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明这个职业的检查单解读、文书、初筛比重不低，这些正被 AI 加速；但问诊、连续性照护与信任关系，是全科医生的核心壁垒。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高风险不等于岗位危险。AI 把全科医生从「写病历、读报告」里解放出来，需求反而转向 AI 替代不了的「长期关系照护」。真正受影响的是只会开药、不愿跟病人的流水线门诊。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 学医选全科方向要有情怀，也要看清路径：临床本科加全科规培，基层有政策支持。AI 时代全科的价值在「长期照护」，把慢病管理、医患沟通练扎实，这条路会越走越宽。
把 AI 辅助工具用起来，省下时间做随访与慢病管理。往全科带教、家庭医生团队负责人方向走；基层职称与待遇政策在改善，别轻易转专科。
全科医生是正规医学路径，没有捷径。想从基层切入可从全科规培开始，签约家庭医生制度让职业路径更清晰；转行前先确认自己能接受门诊量大的节奏。
招全科医生别只看学历，要看「跟病人处得久」的能力——考一个慢病随访案例就能看出风格。基层留住全科医生，待遇、编制和职业发展三样都得给到位。

ai_s7_trends: AI 辅助首诊与文书普及，全科医生把时间还给问诊与随访。
家庭医生签约制度深化，连续性照护需求增长，全科医生更吃香。
基层待遇与职称政策改善，全科方向的职业吸引力上升。

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Farm Labor Contractors, but it will reshape their workflow. Tools can handle repetitive and structured work, while people focus on judgment, accountability, and coordination. Contractors who adapt plans to real conditions and make sound decisions gain value over those who only follow a script.
ai_s2_accel: Use workforce profiles to assess crew and client needs faster.
Use simulations to test staffing and harvest plans.
Use retrieval tools to verify labor information and regulations.
Use collaboration tools to coordinate farms, crews, transportation, and housing.
ai_s2_auto: Automatically generate structured documents and reports for farm-labor contracting.
Process and classify repetitive workforce data.
Perform preliminary rule-based worker screening and scheduling.
Search farm-labor knowledge bases and extract key points.

The ability to explain farm-labor rules and plans to non-specialists.
Accountability and final review in farm-labor contracting.
Coordination of workers, farms, housing, transport, and compliance across boundaries.
Use of tacit knowledge built through long-term farm-labor experience.

Turn farm-labor experience into repeatable services and management systems that increase leverage.
Use AI to reduce repetitive farm-labor administration and focus on decisions and accountability.

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代农场劳务，但会重塑Farm Labor Contractors的作业流：把重复与可结构化任务交给工具，人聚焦判断、责任与创造。真正被挤掉的是照本宣科式执行，会结合真实场景、会决策的人更值钱。
ai_s2_accel: 用数据画像加速Farm Labor Contractors的客情/学情判断。
用模拟与沙盘加速Farm Labor Contractors的方案推演。
用检索增强Farm Labor Contractors的资料与法规查证。

对Farm Labor Contractors的重复性数据处理与归类。

把Farm Labor Contractors专业知识讲给外行听的表达力。
Farm Labor Contractors领域的责任承担与终审。

ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 把 3/10 变成优势：用 AI 解放重复劳动，把时间花在真实项目、判断与人际上。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 先把Farm Labor Contractors基础打牢，积累真实项目。

把Farm Labor Contractors经验产品化/管理化，放大杠杆。
用 AI 解放Farm Labor Contractors重复劳动，聚焦决策。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can adjust parameters, but an experienced operator must still verify that the die is seated correctly.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 8,800 Forging Machine Setters, Operators, And Tenders, Metal And Plastic employed in 2024. Employment is projected to fall to 7,200 by 2034, a net decrease of about 1,600 jobs, with roughly 600 openings each year. Median annual pay is about $49,200 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Forging Machine Setters, Operators, And Tenders, Metal And Plastic. Parameter setup, quality inspection, and production records will become more automated. Die changes, machine setup, defect diagnosis, and incident response still depend on practical experience because machines cannot repair every problem on the line.
ai_s2_accel: Process control optimization: AI adjusts settings in real time to maintain forming consistency
Predictive maintenance: vibration and oil-temperature data indicate potential failures
Robotic loading and unloading: robotic arms move materials and handle machine loading
Digital-twin die trials: virtual commissioning shortens die-change validation
ai_s2_auto: Process parameter setup: smart systems recommend settings based on the material and die
Quality inspection: vision systems identify cracks, incomplete filling, and other defects
Production records: systems collect and report output and equipment data
Heating and temperature control: furnaces regulate temperature automatically
ai_s3_list: Practical die changing and setup. Correct seating and clearance depend on skilled inspection and adjustment.
Defect-cause analysis. Cracking can result from temperature, the die, or the billet, so diagnosis requires a combined assessment.
Equipment incident response. Experienced operators use sound, vibration, and temperature to locate jams and other faults.
Safe operating judgment. High-temperature, high-pressure, high-speed equipment demands constant attention to safety.
On-site process improvement. Experienced operators know how to reduce flash and increase throughput.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 reflects a role dominated by physical work and on-site judgment. Automation can replace some tasks, but adoption is gradual and die changing and setup remain experience-intensive. Exposure is therefore low-moderate.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low-moderate exposure still brings material change. Smart production lines reduce jobs centered on watching machines. Operators who can set up equipment and troubleshoot faults will command more value.

ai_s5_persona.advice: Study metalworking or CNC machining at a technical school. Building both operating and process knowledge creates more options than learning only machine operation.
Learn smart equipment and vision-inspection systems. Moving from machine tending into setup and process work can increase earning potential.
A background in machinery or fitting supports a faster transition. A resume should describe independent die changes and faults resolved, not only years of machine operation.
Hire and retain operators who can set up machines and troubleshoot, not only start equipment. Pair them with smart inspection systems to reduce repetitive manual checks.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 会调参数，但模具装没装正，还得师傅上手。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年机器铺设工、操作员、看护员、金属塑料在岗约 0.88 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 0.72 万人，岗位净减约 0.16 万个，年均产生约 0.06 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.92 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: 直接回答：AI 不会取代锻造机操作员，但参数设定、质量检测、生产记录会越来越自动化。真正被留下的价值是换模调机、缺陷判断和异常处置——这些靠手感、靠经验，产线上出了问题，机器自己不会修。
ai_s2_accel: 过程控制优化：AI 实时调参，保持成型一致性
预测性维护：设备振动与油温数据预判故障
机器人上下料：机械臂承担搬运与上下料
数字孪生试模：虚拟调试缩短换模验证时间
ai_s2_auto: 工艺参数设定：智能系统按材料与模具自动给参数
质量检测：视觉检测自动识别裂纹、充不满等缺陷
生产记录：产量与设备数据自动采集上报
加热与温度控制：加热炉自动控温，减少人工盯表
ai_s3_list: 换模与调机手感。模具装没装平、间隙对不对，AI 给不出感觉，全靠手上功夫。
缺陷原因分析。成型件开裂，是温度、模具还是坯料问题，要综合判断。
设备异常处置。卡料、异响、油温异常，老手一听一摸就知道问题在哪。
安全操作意识。高温、高压、高速的设备面前，安全意识是底线。
现场工艺改进。怎么减少飞边、怎么提速，老师傅的改进建议最值钱。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 评分 4/10 的逻辑：这个岗位大部分是物理操作和现场判断——机器替代空间有，但自动化节奏偏慢，且换模调机高度依赖经验。所以曝光分偏低。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于没变化。智能产线正在逐条上线，纯「看机」的活会越来越少，而「会调机、能排障」的复合型师傅会越来越抢手。

ai_s5_persona.advice: 读技校学金属加工或数控方向，把「会操作 + 懂工艺」两个都拿下，比单学一个强。
主动学智能设备和视觉检测系统，从看机往调机、工艺方向走，涨薪空间大。
有机械、钳工背景的切入快。把「独立换模、处理过哪些故障」写进简历，比单纯写操作年限有用。
别只招「会开机的」，重点留「会调机、能排障」的师傅；配智能检测系统做辅助，减少人工重复检查。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can suggest differential diagnoses, draft records, and send follow-up reminders, but the physician still identifies the patient's main problem, sets treatment priorities, and explains the plan.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 73,200 physicians in 2024, projected to rise to 75,600 by 2034. That is a net gain of about 2,400 jobs, with roughly 2,100 annual openings. Median annual pay is about $236,400 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace General Internal Medicine Physicians, but it will assist initial assessment and documentation. Decision support, record generation, and follow-up reminders speed up administrative work, shifting physicians toward diagnosis, differential reasoning, chronic disease management, and patient trust. Clinicians who combine diagnostic skill with empathy gain value.
ai_s2_auto: Assisted generation of differential diagnosis lists
ai_s3_list: Diagnostic direction: the physician decides which condition to treat first.
Physical examination judgment: touch and bedside observation remain human skills.
Medication decisions: physicians decide how to adjust treatment.
Patient trust: physicians decide how to explain difficult information.
Referral judgment: physicians decide whether and when to refer.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 6/10 score places this occupation in a moderate AI exposure range. Documentation and initial assessment support are accelerating, while diagnosis and trust remain human responsibilities.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure does not equal replacement. AI takes over form filling and list generation, not differential diagnosis, prescribing, or trust building. Clinicians with strong clinical and coordination skills become more valuable.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation in clinical medicine and complete broad internal medicine rotations. As documentation shrinks, develop differential reasoning and empathetic communication early.
Move beyond writing records into differential diagnosis and chronic disease management. Learn decision-support tools and work toward attending-level or subspecialty responsibility.
Highlight licensure, real outpatient volume, and the conditions you have managed. Employers value reliable clinical judgment and coordination.
Do not hire on education alone. Assess whether the physician can manage uncertainty and coordinate referrals; that ability deserves stronger performance compensation.

ai_s7_trends: Assistive tools improve efficiency and reduce documentation.
Aging populations and chronic disease increase demand.
Physicians who can differentiate conditions and build trust are increasingly sought after.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能帮列鉴别、写病历、给随访提醒，但这个病人主线是什么、先治哪、话怎么讲，还是内科医师定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年普通内科医师在岗约 7.32 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 7.56 万人，净增约 0.24 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.21 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 23.64 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代内科医师，但会辅助初诊与文书。辅助决策、病历生成和随访提醒把事务提速，医师从「写记录」挪向「诊断、鉴别、慢病管理与医患信任」。真正被提速的是文书，能鉴别会共情的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 诊断主线：先治哪靠人。
查体判断：手感靠人。
用药决策：怎么调靠人。
医患信任：话怎么讲靠人。
转诊把握：转不转靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光区——文书与初诊辅助被加速，但诊断与信任还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于被替：被替代的是「填表、列清单」的动作，不是「鉴别、开药、建信任」的岗位。有临床力和协调力的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只会走流程的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 临床本科打底，在校多轮转内科。AI 时代文书在缩，早点练鉴别和共情。
从「写病历」升级成「做鉴别 + 管慢病」，学辅助工具，争取当主治或亚专业。
突出执业和真实门诊量，写清跟过哪些病种。机构看重稳和协调。
选人别只看学历，要看会不会兜底。能协调转诊的，值得给高绩效。

ai_s7_trends: 辅助工具提效，文书缩。
老龄慢病拉动需求。
会鉴别建信任的更抢手。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can generate images, but Graphic Designers still decide which style fits, how visuals express a brand, and whether the aesthetics meet the standard.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 265,900 workers in 2024, projected to rise to 271,500 by 2034. That is a net gain of about 5,600 jobs, with roughly 20,000 annual openings. Median annual pay is about $61,300 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Graphic Designers, but it will reduce standard roles. Generative tools and templates accelerate routine work, shifting Designers toward creative direction, brand judgment, and aesthetic quality control. People limited to standard assets face displacement, while those with strong direction and review ability become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Creative direction: people define the tone.
Brand judgment: people decide whether the work fits.
Aesthetic quality control: people set the standard.
Requirement translation: people clarify ambiguity.
Live presentations: people persuade stakeholders.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 7/10 score places this occupation in a moderate-high AI exposure range. Systems accelerate standard visual production, while people retain responsibility for direction and quality control.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure does not equal high risk. AI replaces standard artwork tasks, not visual creative roles. Designers with direction and review ability become scarcer as productivity rises. People limited to templates face the greatest pressure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Begin with art or design and practice aesthetics and software. Template-only work is shrinking in the AI era, so develop creative direction early.
Progress from standard deliverables to setting direction and managing brands, and learn strategy.
Emphasize portfolio work and brand experience, clearly identifying the industries you have served. Employers value consistent taste and execution.
Do not evaluate candidates only by software speed. Assess their sense of direction, and pay a premium for senior Designers capable of quality control.

ai_s7_trends: AI image generation is spreading, reducing standard roles.
Brand and creative direction create opportunities.
Designers with aesthetic quality-control skills are in greater demand.

body: Graphic Designers turn information, brands, and goals into visual work. They coordinate typography, color, layout, and composition and use design software to create print and digital materials that communicate clearly and attractively.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can generate images, but Graphic Designers still decide which style fits, how visuals express a brand, and whether the aesthetics meet the standard.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能出图，但哪类风格对味、怎么讲成品牌语言、审美怎么把关，还是设计师定。

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代平面设计师，但会压缩标准岗。生成式工具与模板把常规稿提速，设计师从「画标准图」挪向「创意方向、品牌判断、审美把关」。真正被挤掉的是只做标准稿的，有方向感能把关的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 创意方向：调性靠人定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Automated sectioning and scanning improve speed, but technicians still decide quality control, difficult specimens, and special staining.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 351,200 histology technicians employed in 2024, projected to reach 357,200 by 2034. That is a net increase of about 6,000 jobs, with roughly 22,600 annual openings. Median annual pay is about $61,900 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace histology technicians, but it will reduce repetitive operations. Automated microtomes, stainers, and whole-slide scanners accelerate standard slide preparation, shifting technicians from manual production toward quality control, special stains, difficult cases, and collaboration with pathology. Workers limited to standard procedures face pressure, while strong quality-control capability gains value.
ai_s3_list: Quality control: one incorrect slide can alter a life.
Difficult-specimen handling: experience remains human.
Special staining: people adjust protocols.
Pathology collaboration: interpretation requires communication.
Process accountability: people remain responsible for specimens.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 5/10 score places the occupation in a moderate AI exposure laboratory range. Systems accelerate standard slide preparation, but people retain quality control and special staining.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure does not equal high risk. Standard-procedure actions face replacement, not quality-controlled slide preparation. Technicians who handle difficult cases and quality control become scarcer as efficiency rises; those limited to standard programs face risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Begin in medical laboratory science and practice slide preparation and quality control. Pure process execution is shrinking in the AI era, so build quality-control capability early.
Advance from manual slide preparation to quality control plus special staining, and learn digital pathology.
Emphasize slide volume and quality-control experience and specify the departments supported.
Do not recruit only for speed; assess quality-control thinking. Core workers who handle difficult cases merit higher compensation.

ai_s7_trends: Automated slide preparation spreads and reduces standard roles.
Digital pathology creates quality-control opportunities.
Special-stain and quality-control talent becomes more competitive.

body: Histology technicians process human tissue specimens in pathology laboratories. They fix, dehydrate, embed, section, stain, and coverslip tissue to prepare slides for pathologists' diagnostic interpretation.

与病理联动：判读靠人沟通。

ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业处在中 AI 曝光的检验区——标准制片被系统加速，但质控与特殊染色还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「跑标准流程」动作，不是「质控制片」的岗位。有质控力、能处理疑难的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只会跑标准程序的技术员。

Algorithm assessment and talent platforms speed up standard analysis, and psychologists move from "score calculation" to "program design, organizational diagnosis, and interpersonal judgment." What is really being squeezed out is pure analysis. People who understand people and can design are more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Program design: Organizations rely on human diagnosis.
Interpersonal Judgment: People are judged by others.
Organizational Diagnosis: Pain points are discovered by people.
Promoted by implementation: Change depends on people.
Customer communication: people uncover needs.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 shows that this profession is in the medium-to-high exposure area - some links are accelerated by the system, but there is still room for the areas that really require judgment and assurance.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Medium and high exposure does not mean high risk: what is replaced is the action of "calculating standard points", not the position of "program design and diagnosis". People who understand people and can design are becoming more scarce as efficiency improves. What I'm afraid of is that it will only run data.

ai_s5_persona.建议: When starting out in psychology, practice more statistics and consulting. In the AI ​​era, pure analysis is shrinking, so practice design as early as possible.
Upgrade from "score calculation" to "diagnosis + plan" and learn organization and communication.
Highlight projects and results, and companies value implementation and stability.
When selecting people, don’t just look at academic qualifications, look at insights and expressions. Backbones are worthy of big projects.

ai_s7_trends: Automated assessment is widespread and analysis is shrinking.
Scheme design brings opportunities.
Psychologists who understand people are more stable.

方案设计带来机会。
懂人的心理家更稳。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can automatically generate schedules and meeting minutes, but "whether this function should be implemented and how to determine the priority" depends on the project manager's business judgment.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), there will be approximately 472,000 information managers on the job in 2024, and this number is expected to rise to 510,500 by 2034, with a net increase of approximately 38,500 positions, an average of approximately 31,300 job vacancies per year, and a median annual salary of approximately US$109,000 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace IT project managers, but it will take over much of the process layer. Requirements documents, schedules, meeting notes, and progress reports can all be automated. Business understanding, risk decisions, team coordination, and stakeholder management still rely on people. As AI increases project volume and speed, project managers who organize teams and deliver results become more valuable.
ai_s2_accel: AI risk warning exposes postponement risks in advance
Intelligent code review assists quality control
Data analysis assists resource optimization decision-making
ai_s2_auto: Requirements document and PRD draft generation
Scheduling planning and task disassembly automation
Meeting minutes and post-meeting to-do generation
Progress reports and weekly reports are automatically summarized
ai_s3_list: Business understanding: Translate fuzzy requirements into tasks that the team can do.
Risk-based decision-making: Dare to make a decision when schedule and quality conflict.
Team leader: Let development, testing, and business be willing to follow you.
Stakeholder management: Balance the expectations of bosses, customers, and colleagues.
On-site judgment: When something goes wrong online, you know what to do first.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 explains that the "process layer" of IT project management is being heavily reconstructed by AI: documents, scheduling, minutes, and reports can all be automated, and the space for purely tool-based PM is shrinking. However, the success or failure of the project ultimately depends on decision-making and leadership. AI devalues ​​“managing things” and increases the value of “managing people and judgment”.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Medium and high exposure is a signal of evolution: stop being a "human Jira" - hand over the scheduling minutes to AI and spend your time on business understanding and team leadership. Project managers who understand both technology and business and can use AI to improve efficiency are scarce resources in the AI ​​era.

ai_s5_persona.建议: It is recommended to learn technology or business first, and then switch to project management - PMs without technical background are easily led away by the team. Computer and information management majors are related to each other. During college, I participated in many project practices. PM is something that can be "made" rather than "passed by exams".

Use AI project management tools to get rid of the role of document slave. Deepen business understanding and industry knowledge, obtain PMP or Agile certification, and at the same time maintain technical sensitivity and avoid being too far away from the front line.

There are advantages in transferring to PM in development, testing, product, and business positions. The key is to come up with "completely delivered project cases." During the interview, clearly explaining "what you have managed, how to schedule, and how to put out fires" is more useful than a bunch of certifications.

When recruiting PMs, don’t just look at certificates. Focus on business understanding, risk decision-making and upward management capabilities. Equip project managers with AI tools to reduce documentation burden, and focus assessments on delivery quality and team health.

ai_s7_trends: AI takes over documentation and scheduling, and project managers shift from "process managers" to "decision leaders."
AI makes projects smaller and faster, and short-cycle agile delivery has become mainstream.
The composite ability of "Business Understanding + Technical Sensitivity + Team Leadership" determines the PM ceiling.

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代 IT 项目经理，但会接管流程层：需求文档、排期计划、会议纪要、进度报告都能自动化。项目管理的核心——业务理解、风险决策、团队协调、干系人管理——依然靠人。AI 时代项目更多、节奏更快，能把人组织好、把事做成的项目经理只会更值钱。
ai_s2_accel: AI 风险预警提前暴露延期风险
代码智能评审辅助质量把控
数据分析辅助资源优化决策
AI 助手协调跨团队沟通
ai_s2_auto: 需求文档与 PRD 初稿生成
排期计划与任务拆解自动化
会议纪要与会后待办生成
进度报告与周报自动汇总
ai_s3_list: 业务理解：把模糊需求翻译成团队能做的任务。
风险决策：进度与质量冲突时敢拍板。
团队领导：让开发、测试、业务愿意跟着你冲。
干系人管理：老板、客户、同事多方预期平衡。
现场判断：上线出问题时知道先救什么。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明 IT 项目管理的「流程层」正被 AI 重度重构：文档、排期、纪要、报告都能自动化，纯工具型 PM 的空间在收缩。但项目的成败最终取决于决策与领导，AI 让「管事」贬值，让「管人、管判断」升值。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光是进化信号：别再做「人肉 Jira」——把排期纪要交给 AI，把时间花在业务理解和团队领导上。懂技术又懂业务、会用 AI 提效的项目经理，在 AI 时代是稀缺资源。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 建议先学技术或业务，再转项目管理——没有技术底子的 PM 容易被团队牵着走。计算机、信息管理专业都对口，大学期间多参加项目实践，PM 是「做出来」的不是「考出来」的。
把 AI 项目管理工具用起来，摆脱文档奴隶的角色。往业务理解和行业知识深耕，考取 PMP 或敏捷认证，同时保持技术敏感度，别离一线太远。
开发、测试、产品、业务岗转 PM 都有优势，关键是拿得出「完整交付的项目案例」。面试时讲清楚「你管过什么、怎么排期、怎么救过火」，比一堆认证有用。
招聘 PM 别只看证书，重点考察业务理解、风险决策和向上管理能力。给项目经理配 AI 工具减少文档负担，把考核重心放在交付质量和团队健康度上。

ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「标准访问」动作，不是「真实采集」的岗位。会听、会问的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只会照稿念的面谈员。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 语言/社科起步多练表达和听，AI 时代纯访问在缩，早点练追问。
从「念提纲」升级成「做深度 + 跟难样本」，学质检和分析。
突出耐心和样本量，写清跟过哪些项目。机构看重稳和准。
选人别只看嘴皮子，要看细不细、会不会听。能跟难样本的骨干值得留。

ai_s7_trends: 在线问卷普及，标准岗缩。
深度与难样本带来机会。
会追问的面谈员更抢手。

body: 信息面谈员（不含资格与贷款类）通过电话或面对面，按提纲采集受访者态度、行为与经历等信息，记录并初筛样本，支撑市场与社情调研。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 自动语音能念提纲，但哪句要追问、哪段情绪要捕捉、怎么把人聊透，还是面谈员定。

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Mechatronics Engineers, but it will reshape their work. Generative design and control optimization accelerate routine development, shifting engineers from single-domain code toward system definition, integration, and field responsibility. Single-specialty roles face pressure, while professionals spanning mechanical, electrical, and software domains gain value.
ai_s3_list: System integration: people design the architecture
On-site commissioning: people make judgments
Cross-domain coordination: people make the final decision
Exception handling: people provide experience
Tradeoffs: people carry responsibility

ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure does not equal high risk. Automation replaces repetitive single-domain tasks, not cross-domain integration. Professionals who combine mechanical, electrical, control, and software knowledge become scarcer.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build mechanical and electrical foundations and learn software early
Expand from one domain into three-domain expertise
Highlight integration and commissioning experience
Choose professionals with interdisciplinary skills who are willing to work on site

Digital twins become widespread
Interdisciplinary professionals are in greater demand

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代这个岗位，但会重塑它。生成式设计与控制优化提速常规开发，工程师从「写单域代码」转向「定系统、做集成、担现场」。真正被挤掉的是只守单专业的，懂三域复合的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 系统集成：架构靠人
现场联调：判断靠人

异常处置：经验靠人

ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「单域重复」动作，不是「跨界集成」的岗位。懂机电气软复合的人反而更稀缺。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Autonomous rollers can compact regular road sections, but operators still decide how to navigate complex intersections, finish edges, and coordinate the site.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that about 47,000 equipment operators were employed in 2024. By 2034, employment is projected to reach 48,600, a net increase of about 1,600 jobs, with about 4,000 openings per year. The median annual salary is about $51,700 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace paving equipment operators, but it will reduce routine roles. Autonomous and remote-controlled rollers take over straight sections, shifting workers from pure driving toward complex terrain, equipment dispatch, quality testing, and on-site coordination. People limited to standard sections face displacement, while operators who handle multiple machines and dispatching become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Positioning on complex roads: people provide experience.
Edge compaction: people exercise judgment.
On-site dispatch: people coordinate.
Quality trade-offs: people uphold standards.
Emergency response: people react.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 indicates moderately high exposure in on-site work. Automated equipment absorbs straight road sections, while complex areas, edges, and dispatching retain a human role.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not mean high risk. Compacting standard sections faces replacement, not complex-road and dispatch roles. Operators who handle multiple machines and understand the site become scarcer as automation spreads. People limited to one machine on straight roads face greater risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Start with construction machinery at a vocational school and earn an operator license early. Pure roller work is shrinking.
Advance from one machine to multiple machines + dispatching, and learn quality control.
Highlight how many machine types you operate, your licenses, and the projects you have completed.
When hiring, assess dispatch and quality judgment, not driving ability alone.

ai_s7_trends: Autonomous driving takes over regular sections.
Multiple-machine and dispatch skills retain workers.
On-site quality control receives greater emphasis.

body: Paving, surfacing, and tamping equipment operators use paving and compaction equipment to place asphalt, concrete, and other surface courses while controlling thickness, grade, and density, performing a critical step in leveling roads and sites.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Autonomous rollers can compact regular road sections, but operators still decide how to navigate complex intersections, finish edges, and coordinate the site.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 自动驾驶压路机能压规则段，但复杂路口怎么走、边角怎么补、现场怎么调度，还是操作员定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年设备操作员在岗约 4.70 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 4.86 万人，净增约 0.16 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.40 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 5.17 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代铺路设备操作员，但会压缩规则岗。自动驾驶与遥控压路机接管平直路段，工人从「纯驾驶」挪向「复杂路况、设备调度、质量检测、现场协同」。真正被挤掉的是只压标准段的，会多设备会调度的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 复杂路况走位：经验靠人。
边角补压：判断靠人。
现场调度：协调靠人。
质量取舍：标准靠人。
应急处突：反应靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的现场区——平直路段被自动设备吃，但复杂、边角、调度仍留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「压标准段」动作，不是「复杂路况与调度」的岗位。会多设备、懂现场的人，反而随自动化更稀缺。怕的是只会开单种设备压直路。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 职校工程机械起步，早点考操作证，纯压路在缩。
从「单设备」升级成「多设备 + 调度」，学质控。
突出会几种设备、有操作证，写清做过的项目。
选人别只看会开，要看会不会调度和判质量。

ai_s7_trends: 自动驾驶占规则段。
多设备与调度留人。
现场质控更被看重。

body: 铺路、路面与夯实设备操作员操作铺筑与压实设备，铺设沥青、混凝土等面层并控制厚度、坡度与密实度，是道路与场地平整的关键工序。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 自动驾驶压路机能压规则段，但复杂路口怎么走、边角怎么补、现场怎么调度，还是操作员定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Assessment equipment can measure joint angles, but a therapist's eyes and hands still determine whether to remove the walker for the next step and whether the patient is afraid.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 267,200 physical therapists were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 296,400 by 2034, a net increase of about 29,200 jobs, with about 13,200 openings annually and a 2026 median annual salary of about $101,000 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace physical therapists, but it will accelerate assessment and documentation. Assessment equipment, rehabilitation robots, and electronic records speed up initial evaluations and training, shifting therapists from routine exercises toward plan design, manual therapy, and supportive motivation. Standardized training will be displaced, while clinicians who design treatment become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Plan design: people make the tradeoffs.
Manual therapy: people provide tactile skill.
Supportive motivation: people build confidence.
On-site judgment: people read responses.
Interprofessional collaboration: people control the pace.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 5/10 places this occupation in a moderately AI-exposed assessment field. Systems accelerate evaluation and documentation, but treatment and companionship still require people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-to-high exposure does not mean high risk. What gets replaced is standardized training and documentation, not plan design roles. Therapists with strong clinical skills who support patients become scarcer as efficiency rises. Those who only lead exercises from a checklist face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation in rehabilitation therapy and practice anatomy and clinical work at school. Standard training is shrinking in the AI era, so develop plan-design skills early.
Advance from leading exercises to assessment + plan design, develop a subspecialty, and seek responsibility for outpatient care.
Emphasize clinical and subspecialty cases, and specify the conditions you have treated. Institutions value reliability and specialization.
When hiring, assess more than exercise skills; look for clinical understanding. PTs who design treatment deserve higher performance pay.

ai_s7_trends: Assessment robots improve efficiency while standardized training shrinks.
Demand rises for geriatric rehabilitation.
Clinically skilled designers are scarcer.

body: Physical therapists assess motor function and pain, design personalized rehabilitation plans, and use manual techniques, exercise, and physical therapy equipment to help patients regain mobility after surgery, injury, or chronic illness. They lead functional recovery in rehabilitation systems.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Assessment equipment can measure joint angles, but a therapist's eyes and hands still determine whether to remove the walker for the next step and whether the patient is afraid.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 评估设备能量出关节角度，但那步该不该撤助行器、患者怕不怕，还是治疗师的眼和手定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年物理治疗师在岗约 26.72 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 29.64 万人，净增约 2.92 万个岗位，年均产生约 1.32 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 10.10 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代物理治疗师，但会加速评估与记录。评估设备、康复机器人和电子病历把初评与训练提速，治疗师从「做常规训练」挪向「方案设计、手法治疗、陪伴激励」。真正被挤掉的是标准化训练，懂临床能设计的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 方案设计：取舍靠人。
手法治疗：手感靠人。
陪伴激励：信心靠人。
现场判断：反应靠人。
跨专业协同：节奏靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业处在中等 AI 曝光的评估区——测评与记录被系统加速，但治疗与陪伴还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「标准化训练与记录」动作，不是「方案设计」的岗位。有临床力、能陪人的治疗师，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只按表带操的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 康复治疗打底，在校多练解剖与临床。AI 时代标准训练在缩，早点练方案。
从「带操」升级成「做评估 + 方案」，学亚专科，争取当门诊负责。
突出临床与亚专科案例，写清跟过哪些病种。机构看重稳和专。
选人别只看会练，要看懂不懂临床。能设计的 PT，值得给高绩效。

ai_s7_trends: 评估机器人提效，训练缩。
老龄康复需求升。
懂临床会设计的更缺。

body: 物理治疗师评估运动功能与疼痛，设计个性化康复方案，运用手法、运动与理疗设备帮助患者术后、伤后或慢病恢复活动能力，是康复体系里的功能恢复主导。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 评估设备能量出关节角度，但那步该不该撤助行器、患者怕不怕，还是治疗师的眼和手定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Systems can collect data and generate tables automatically, but sustainability specialists still decide where to cut emissions, how to set targets, and how to engage the supply chain.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that about 1,205,700 sustainability specialists were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 1,242,000 by 2034, a net increase of about 36,300 jobs, with about 108,200 openings each year on average. The median annual wage in 2026 was about $81,300 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace sustainability specialists, but it will accelerate accounting. Carbon accounting and ESG data collection speed up repetitive work, shifting specialists from collecting data and filling forms toward strategy, supply chain coordination, disclosure judgment, and stakeholder communication. People who only enter data face displacement, while those who can coordinate and drive implementation become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Strategy development: people determine the pathway.
Supply chain coordination: people drive emissions reductions.
Disclosure judgment: people control definitions.
Stakeholder communication: people build trust.
Balancing targets: people make tradeoffs.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 7/10 places this occupation in a moderately high exposure area of disclosure work. Systems accelerate data and reporting, but people retain an essential role in strategy and coordination.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not mean high risk. What gets replaced is data entry and form filling, not sustainability coordination. People with strategic ability who can drive supply chain action become scarcer as productivity rises. Assistants who only collect data face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation with a bachelor's degree in environmental studies or management, and study accounting methods and frameworks while in school. Pure data collection is shrinking in the AI era, so develop strategy skills early.
Advance from filling forms to developing strategy plus driving the supply chain. Learn carbon tools and seek ownership of a workstream.
Highlight accounting and disclosure experience and specify the emissions-reduction initiatives you have advanced. Companies value reliability and execution.
When hiring, look beyond certificates and assess whether candidates can drive action. Core contributors who turn targets into results deserve strong compensation.

ai_s7_trends: Accounting becomes automated and data collection shrinks.
Carbon-neutrality goals and ESG create opportunities.
Specialists with strong strategic drive are in greater demand.

body: Sustainability specialists lead corporate environmental and social responsibility management. They coordinate carbon emissions, energy use, and ESG, apply accounting and disclosure frameworks, advance emissions reduction and compliance, and communicate externally.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Systems can collect data and generate tables automatically, but sustainability specialists still decide where to cut emissions, how to set targets, and how to engage the supply chain.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 系统能自动采数和出表，但减哪里、目标怎么定、供应链怎么推，还是专员定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年可持续发展专员在岗约 120.57 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 124.20 万人，净增约 3.63 万个岗位，年均产生约 10.82 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 8.13 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代可持续专员，但会加速核算。碳核算与 ESG 数据采集把重复工作提速，专员从「收数填表」挪向「战略、供应链协调、披露判断、利益相关方沟通」。真正被挤掉的是只做数据录入的，有统筹力能推事的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 战略制定：路径靠人定。
供应链协调：减排靠人推。
披露判断：口径靠人握。
利益沟通：信任靠人建。
目标平衡：取舍靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的披露区——数据与报表被系统加速，但战略与协调还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「数据录入与填表」动作，不是「可持续统筹」的岗位。有战略力、能推供应链的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只做收数的助理。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 环境/管理本科打底，在校多摸核算和框架。AI 时代纯收数在缩，早点练战略。
从「填表」升级成「做战略 + 推供应链」，学碳工具，争取负责模块。
突出核算和披露经验，写清推过哪些减排。企业看重稳和推。
选人别只看证书，要看有没有推事脑子。能落目标的骨干，值得给高薪。

ai_s7_trends: 核算自动化，收数缩。
双碳与 ESG 带来机会。
有战略推力的专员更抢手。

body: 可持续发展专员主导企业的环境与社会责任管理，统筹碳排、能耗与 ESG，运用核算与披露框架，推进减排与合规并对外沟通。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 系统能自动采数和出表，但减哪里、目标怎么定、供应链怎么推，还是专员定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can generate drafts, but people still define the information architecture, assess the experience, and determine how to implement it with frontend developers.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), in 2024 about 128,900 web and digital interface designers were employed. By 2034, employment is projected to rise to 137,900, a net gain of about 9,000 jobs, with approximately 9,100 openings each year. For 2026, the median annual wage is about $98,100 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace interface designers, but it will reduce junior-level visual production. Generative tools accelerate drafting, shifting designers from pushing pixels toward defining structure, assessing experiences, connecting business goals, and governing standards. People who only produce standard visuals are being displaced, while those with strong experience judgment become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Information architecture: people define the structure.
Experience judgment: people make the tradeoffs.
Business alignment: people define the goals.
User empathy: people develop understanding.
Standards governance: people ensure consistency.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: AI exposure is moderate. Generative tools absorb junior drafting, but people remain essential for structural judgment and experience design.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: High exposure does not mean high risk. Standard visual-production tasks are being replaced, not roles that make the experience work. Professionals with judgment and standards expertise become scarcer and more valuable as efficiency improves.

ai_s5_persona.建议: When starting in design, develop user-research and structural skills. Pure visual work is shrinking in the AI era, so build judgment early.
Advance from producing drafts to defining structure + governing standards, and learn user research and business fundamentals.
Highlight experience decisions in your portfolio and clearly identify the products you have worked on.
When hiring, look beyond visual appeal and assess whether candidates can explain their experience decisions.

ai_s7_trends: Generative tools spread, reducing junior drafting.
Demand for experience judgment rises.
Professionals with strong structural thinking are in greater demand.

body: Web and digital interface designers create visual and interactive interfaces for websites and applications. They coordinate layouts, components, and user flows to improve the usability and experience of digital products.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can generate drafts, but people still define the information architecture, assess the experience, and determine how to implement it with frontend developers.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能出稿，但信息架构怎么定、体验怎么判、和前端怎么落地，还是人定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年网页与数字界面设计师在岗约 12.89 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 13.79 万人，净增约 0.90 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.91 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 9.81 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代界面设计师，但会压缩初级视觉产出。生成式工具出稿提速，设计师从「画像素」挪向「定结构、判体验、连业务、带规范」。真正被挤掉的是只产出标准视觉的，有体验判断力的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 信息架构：结构靠人定。
体验判断：取舍靠人。
业务连接：目标靠人。
用户共情：理解靠人。
规范治理：一致性靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: AI 曝光中等——生成式吃初级稿，但结构判断与体验还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「标准视觉产出」动作，不是「把体验做对」的岗位。有判断力和规范力的人，反而随提效更稀缺。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 设计起步多练用研与结构，AI 时代纯视觉在缩，早点练判断。
从「出稿」升级成「定结构 + 带规范」，学用研和业务。
突出作品集里的体验决策，写清服务过哪些产品。
选人别只看美不美，要看会不会讲体验决策。

ai_s7_trends: 生成式普及，初级稿缩。
体验判断需求升。
有结构力者更抢手。
